rule: C2 = the smallest lr in lr_grid whose merged model has forget retention <= 0.25 (all 20 forget10 authors) and retain retention >= 0.50. If no lr meets both, C2 = the lr with the lowest forget retention among those with retain retention >= 0.50, and the entry says the target was missed. If every lr has retain retention < 0.50, stop and report (no C2).
